items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: I made a set of drums for me to go play with Foster Lewis. Finally, we played... Foster Lewis had a pretty good band.

ctx.x: I knew him, Foster Lewis. Jude Foster. We had nicknames, but the real name is Foster. That word's name is Lewis Foster. We called him Foster Lewis. He did a great German one band. Jude Foster was his brother. Trumpet.
